movies.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
movies.tagline: Welcome to the Second Quarter Quell.
movies.synopsis: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before Katniss Everdeen volunteers in her sister's place, commencing on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自苏珊·柯林斯的同名小说。故事发生在《饥饿游戏》事件发生前24年，讲述第50届饥饿游戏（第二次四分区叛乱纪念赛）抽签日当天，年轻的黑密斯·阿伯纳西被选中参赛的故事。

movies.title: Hexed
movies.synopsis: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 一名冲动、不拘一格的少女比莉意外发现自己拥有隐藏的魔法能力，由此进入广阔的女巫王国赫克塞。她与谨慎的母亲艾丽丝联手，揭开可能改变女巫世界的家族秘密。

movies.title: Clayface
movies.synopsis: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.
movies.chineseTagline: 「面」对恐惧
movies.chineseSynopsis: 好莱坞新星马特·哈根遭犯罪头目毁容后，为恢复容貌接受先进治疗，却意外陷入疯狂，走上复仇之路。

movies.title: Everest: The Other Side
movies.synopsis: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest—the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth—something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 真实记录登山滑雪运动员吉姆·莫里森于2025年10月成功沿珠穆朗玛峰北坡霍恩拜因雪沟登顶，并成为全球首位在该危险路线完成滑雪速降的历史性壮举。

movies.title: Traces of Justice
movies.tagline: Four true crimes that shocked China.
movies.synopsis: The film follows criminal police officer Cui Xun over half a century of investigative work. Alongside his colleagues, he solved numerous major cases while staying true to his original aspiration of 'serving the people.' This legendary detective not only witnessed the evolution of China's public security system but also stood as a living testament to the rise of New China.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 凡是经过，皆有痕迹。刑事技术警察崔寻走过半个多世纪，与同事屡破大案，这位秉承着“为人民服务”初心的神探，不仅见证了公安事业的发展，更见证了新中国的崛起。

movies.title: Resident Evil
movies.synopsis: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 奉命奔赴浣熊市的医疗速递员布莱恩，意外深陷全城失控的病毒浩劫。浣熊市彻底沦陷，异变怪物横行肆虐、嗜血猎捕，身陷末日绝境的他，能否在这场惊魂噩梦中突围求生，搏出一线生机？.

movies.title: Dune
movies.synopsis: Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man born into a great destiny beyond his understanding, must travel to the most dangerous planet in the universe to ensure the future of his family and his people. As malevolent forces explode into conflict over the planet's exclusive supply of the most precious resource in existence - a commodity capable of unlocking humanity's greatest potential - only those who can conquer their fear will survive.
movies.chineseTagline: 预见命运，主宰未来。
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自弗兰克·赫伯特的科幻小说《沙丘》。保罗·厄崔迪随家族前往沙漠星球厄拉科斯，卷入围绕珍贵资源“香料”的权力争斗，并逐渐发现自己肩负的命运。

movies.title: The Legend of 1900
movies.tagline: An epic story of a man who could do anything... except be ordinary
movies.synopsis: Musician Max Tooney goes to sell his prized Conn trumpet to a music shop, where he plays the instrument one last time. The shopkeeper recognises the song as one on a record matrix he found and asks who the piece is by. Tooney tells the story of an infant found abandoned in the first class dining room of the four-stacker ocean-liner SS Virginian on 1 January 1900. Danny Boodman, a coal-man from the boiler room, names the boy Danny Boodman T. D. Lemon 1900, after himself, the fruit crate the boy was found in, and the year, and raises him as his own.
movies.chineseTagline: 这是一个关于一个无所不能的男人的史诗故事……唯独无法平凡。
movies.chineseSynopsis: 1900年，一个被遗弃的婴儿出现在往返欧美的弗吉尼亚号上，被船上的锅炉工丹尼收养，并以新世纪的年份取名为“1900”。丹尼意外去世后，1900继续在船上长大，并逐渐展现出无师自通的惊人钢琴天赋，成为弗吉尼亚号上的钢琴师。他的演奏吸引着来自世界各地的乘客，也让他与小号手麦克斯结下深厚友谊。然而无论船只多少次靠岸，1900始终没有真正踏上陆地，对他而言，这艘船和八十八个琴键就是自己熟悉的整个世界。直到一次偶然的邂逅，让从未离开过大海的他第一次认真考虑走下弗吉尼亚号，面对那个没有边界的陌生世界……

movies.title: The Odyssey
movies.synopsis: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.
movies.chineseTagline: 违抗神明，逆天而行。
movies.chineseSynopsis: 克里斯托弗·诺兰将荷马笔下的怪物搬上银幕，打造了一部在全球多地取景拍摄的神话动作史诗。这是一场无与伦比的电影盛事。[环球影业]

movies.title: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East
movies.synopsis: Seeking a fresh start, chef Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to support his family and repay his debts. Alongside restaurant manager Ma Junsheng, he transforms the struggling Dragon Restaurant into a thriving business. But when war engulfs the city, their hard-won success is shattered and the restaurant becomes a refuge for those caught in the conflict. As danger closes in, Xu Fu must risk everything to protect his newfound community and preserve a small beacon of hope amid the devastation.
movies.chineseTagline: 世事千万，好好吃饭
movies.chineseSynopsis: 根据真实事件改编。徐福为养家还债远赴中东，在当地结识大堂经理马俊生。两人以地道中国风味招揽食客，令龙餐馆生意兴隆。然而战争爆发，平静生活被打破，他们将如何面对命运的变故？

movies.title: 指尖谋杀
movies.synopsis: Now screening across Melbourne, Sydney, and Shanghai cinemas.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 一次随手敲击，正在无声吞噬每个人。 　　一段被篡改的影像流传开来，铺天盖地的流言将当事人陈云舒（周依然 饰）推向社会性死亡，无差别围猎不断发酵。始料未及的突发事件层层叠加，反转频出，未婚夫王铮（梁靖康 饰）、检察官丁凡（周放 饰）、好友俞蓉（曾梦雪 饰）等等，越来越多的人被卷入，事态向着更加扑朔迷离的方向发展。受害者、加害者、旁观者、被牵连者，人人都拿着一把“指尖刀”，人人又都被“指尖刀”捅伤。是谁隐匿在黑暗中操控着这一切？真相又是什么？

movies.title: Dune: Part Two
movies.synopsis: Follow the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a path of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, Paul endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.
movies.chineseTagline: 命运将至，传奇再启。
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自弗兰克·赫伯特的科幻小说《沙丘》。保罗·厄崔迪与契妮及弗雷曼人结盟，踏上向摧毁其家族的阴谋者复仇之路。面对挚爱与已知宇宙命运之间的抉择，他必须努力阻止自己预见的可怕未来。

movies.title: Cry Me a Sad River
movies.synopsis: Qi Ming is a handsome boy and he is also a top student at school, but Yi Yao is a so-called bitch on everyone’s lips. Qi and Yi grew up together and they have been maintaining a good relationship. However, everything is interrupted and changed by Tang Xiaomi. Rumors have become a sharp weapon to destroy people. Yi Yao's life falls into darkness, and she suffers all kinds of cruel bullying at school.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 多组校园欺凌事件，打破了5位主角本应该美好的青春校园生活。齐铭（赵英博 饰）清俊帅气，是人人称颂的优等生，而易遥（任敏 饰）却是大家口中的“赔钱货”。两人一同长大，感情很好。而这一切，在转学生唐小米（朱丹妮 饰）出现之后发生了翻天覆地的变化。流言成了毁人利器，处处对易瑶进行刁难，易遥的生活开始陷入黑暗，遭受各类残酷欺凌。顾森西（辛云来 饰）教会易瑶对校园暴力进行反击，他的出现给了易遥一丝曙光。可阴差阳错，顾森湘（章若楠 饰）的意外却将她再度推入黑暗。当受害者变成施暴者，当看客变成助推，在这一场名为“玩笑”的闹剧中，没有旁观者，只有施暴者……

movies.title: We Live in Time
movies.synopsis: An up-and-coming chef and a recent divorcée find their lives forever changed when a chance encounter brings them together, in a decade-spanning, deeply moving romance.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 阿尔穆特与托比亚斯因一次意外相遇，人生从此改变。两人相恋、组建家庭，在时间的考验与生活的变故中，学会珍惜彼此相伴的每一刻。

movies.title: Deep Quiet Room
movies.synopsis: After his pregnant wife Yi-ting unexpectedly committed suicide, Ming decides to take care of his father-in-law, only to find out the unbearable truth of Yi-ting’s family that leads to her death.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 影片改编自林秀赫同名短篇小说。讲述谕明与依庭相遇于大学图书馆里的深度安静区，两人相爱并走入婚姻，正期待迎接第一个孩子。然而，依庭的意外自杀让谕明陷入混乱与痛苦。他想起依庭在怀孕后变得异常，甚至提出离婚。自责的谕明照顾起依庭的家人，透过深入了解她的家庭后，开始理解她的行径，以及她无法面对自己父亲的原因，真相却让人难以接受。

movies.title: The Sound of Malan Flowers Blooming
movies.synopsis: Adapted from a true story of the Beijing Winter Olympics, the film tells the touching story of the Malanhua Children’s Choir. With the help of An Ran, the performance management supervisor for the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, the Winter Olympics team, and Principal Liu from the mountain village primary school, the children overcame numerous hardships to leave their mountain home and step onto the stage of the Beijing Winter Olympics Opening and Closing Ceremonies, singing *Ode to the Olympic* in Greek. Meanwhile, the film reveals more little-known warm and inspiring stories behind the Opening and Closing Ceremonies of the Beijing Winter Olympics and Paralympics, presenting a multi-faceted portrait of the Beijing Winter Olympics Spirit and the Olympic Spirit.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 影片改编自真实的北京冬奥故事，讲述了马兰花儿童声合唱团在开闭幕式演出管理主管安然、冬奥团队以及山村小学刘校长等人的帮助下，如何克服重重困难走出大山、登上北京冬奥会开闭幕式的舞台，用希腊语演唱《奥林匹克颂》的感人故事。同时，影片将展现北京冬奥会冬残奥会开闭幕式背后更多不为人知的温暖励志故事，立体呈现北京冬奥精神和奥林匹克精神。

movies.title: 心迷宫之三重罪
movies.synopsis: Now screening across Melbourne, Sydney, and Shanghai cinemas.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 一具烧焦的无名尸体被发现，引发邻里间的猜疑。大家都在怀疑小肖杀人，虎子的家人企图认尸躲避恶霸追债，琴儿则借尸体摆脱已无感情的丈夫，此时，又有一场意外发生………随着警方调查，真相逐渐浮现。

movies.title: Love Test
movies.synopsis: A woman stages her own disappearance to test her boyfriend's love, only for him to quickly start a passionate relationship with another woman who unknowingly becomes entangled in the original scheme.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 为了测试男友丁伯阳对自己的爱，万影策划了一场失踪事件，让丁伯阳陷入短暂的痛苦中。此时，年轻惹火的马娅趁机上位，与丁伯阳光速热恋，激情同居。可马娅不知道的是，打从自己搬进丁伯阳家的一刻起，自己也成为了这场试探游戏的危险玩家之一…

movies.title: John Wick
movies.synopsis: Ex-hitman John Wick comes out of retirement to track down the gangsters that took everything from him.
movies.chineseTagline: 地表最强杀手 限时疾速追杀
movies.chineseSynopsis: 不久之前刚刚经历丧妻之痛的约翰·威克（基努·里维斯 Keanu Reeves 饰），未曾料到磨难与折磨接二连三袭来。他那辆1964年的福特老爷车被一伙俄罗斯小混混盯上，旋即引来对方入室抢劫，心爱的狗狗被当场杀死，约翰也遭到无情毒打，那辆老爷车自然被对方抢走。偷车的混混（阿尔菲·艾伦 Alfie Allen 饰）是黑帮大佬维格·塔拉索夫（迈克尔·恩奎斯特 Michael Nyqvist 饰）的儿子，而维格在听说这件事后显得紧张非常，因为约翰有着令人胆战心惊的身份。他曾是名震江湖的冷血杀手，当年替塔拉索夫杀掉不少难缠的对手，后来却为了妻子金盆洗手。愤怒至极的约翰拒绝塔拉索夫的调解，他决定单枪匹马展开复仇……

movies.title: 我的身后是祖国
movies.synopsis: Now screening across Melbourne, Sydney, and Shanghai cinemas.
movies.chineseTagline: 历史影象4K超清修复上色 全景式呈现抗美援朝战争
movies.chineseSynopsis: 以抗美援朝战争进程为时间线，围绕“我的身后是祖国”这一主题，采用“凝练字幕+口述”的视听表现形式，从不同的维度，去抓取、剖析和共情中华英雄儿女在抗美援朝战争中的动人瞬间，真实生动地呈现了在“祖国”二字的凝聚下，中华优秀儿女同心同德，赢取抗美援朝战争伟大胜利的波澜壮阔的历史。

movies.title: Hideaway: The Dossiers
movies.synopsis: A secret archive documenting the earliest revolutionary work of the Chinese Communist Party—the "Central Archives"—was successfully protected through the resilience and sacrifices of its guardians (both Party members and non-members) amid the turmoil and bloodshed from 1931 to 1949.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 大革命失败，绝密的中共文件藏匿于一幢人蛇混杂的居民楼。在腥风血雨的环境中，中共文档保管员突破敌伪围剿，在完成延安高难度“调档”任务的同时，将所有秘密文件转移至安全之地。影片取材早期党史的真实历史事件。

movies.title: Heart of the Beast
movies.synopsis: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.
movies.chineseTagline: 生死相依，绝境求生
movies.chineseSynopsis: 一名前陆军特种部队士兵与他退役战犬在阿拉斯加深处遭遇坠机事故后，这对老搭档必须在环境严酷的极地荒野中相互扶持，为生存而战。

movies.title: Demigod: The Legend Begins
movies.synopsis: The martial artist Su Hua-Jen has risked his life clambering to the summit of one of the five sacred mountains of Wu Lin, only to come across two monstrous beings in battle. His timely intervention turns the tide of the fight, and unbeknownst to him, sets in motion a series of monumentally consequential events. Back in the city, Su has a more mundane problem to face—an enormous debt with the local book lender. To pay this off, he must peddle his remarkable skills as a physician. While Su would prefer to steer clear of the affairs of the martial arts world, a request from the Lord of Globe Castle is financially promising—and might gain him access to the Fantastic Academy, where he can feast his eyes on the Limitless Celestial Book. But treachery is afoot, and Su is soon drawn into a crisis that will rock the foundations of Heaven and Earth.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 少年素还真身怀绝艺，初入江湖原想见识广大世界，却因为新结识的好友卷入了险恶的夺权纷争，就连他的老师都因他遭难。

movies.title: Mr. & Mrs. Pardon
movies.synopsis: Middle-aged couple Shen Mo and Tian Yi, facing their third seven-year itch, see their marriage erupt in a bitter clash of accumulated frustration, culminating in a 30-day cooling-off period that seems destined to conclude their relationship.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 沈默和天意是一对中年夫妻，正在经历婚姻的第三个七年之痒，锅碗瓢盆的碰撞，终于让积压许久的烦躁、嫌弃和失望彻底爆发，三十天的离婚冷静期，即将奏响他们婚姻的终曲。

movies.title: Happy Birthday
movies.synopsis: Eight-year-old maid Toha goes to great lengths to ensure that her best friend Nelly, the daughter of her wealthy employer, has a successful birthday party in this poignant debut feature exploring classism in modern-day Cairo.
movies.chineseTagline: 一场生日，两个世界。
movies.chineseSynopsis: 八岁的小女孩托哈在开罗一个富裕家庭当童工女仆，并与雇主的女儿奈莉建立了特殊的联系。从未庆祝过自己生日的托哈下定决心要为奈莉举办一场完美的生日派对，她暗自希望借此体验到自己从未感受过的快乐。

movies.title: For Better or Worse
movies.synopsis: When they first met at Yuan Bo's secularization party, Li Xinran was still an actress suffering from depression. The two, both at the lowest point in their lives, fell in love at first sight and quickly came together, welcoming their first child. With several million yuan in savings, they envisioned an ideal life, but due to extravagance and a lack of financial management experience, they fell into an economic crisis. To turn their situation around, Yuan Bo planned to establish a handpan instrument factory in the mountains of Anji. The lush greenery seemed like their utopian dream. However, with the birth of their second child, their business failed, their business partner left, and they were burdened with debt. The daily grind and financial pressure gradually eroded their once passionate relationship. Deep in the mountains, they loved each other until they had nothing left but each other.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 相识于原博的还俗派对时，李欣冉还是位身患抑郁症的女演员。处于人生低谷的俩人一见钟情，他们迅速走到一起，迎来第一个孩子。带着几百万积蓄，他们憧憬着理想生活，却因挥霍和缺乏理财经验，陷入了经济危机。为扭转困境，原博计划在安吉山中创办手碟乐器工厂。青山绿水似乎是他们梦想中的乌托邦。然而，随着第二个孩子的降生，事业夭折，合伙人离开，债务缠身。日常琐碎与经济压力逐渐蚕食了曾经炙热的感情。在深山中，他们爱到一无所有，只剩彼此。

movies.title: Live Flesh
movies.tagline: Life, love, desire... and everything in between.
movies.synopsis: When Victor attempts to seduce Elena, all he gets for his trouble is a one-way, six-year ticket to prison, where he concentrates on strengthening his mind, his body... and his desire for vengeance on the man who put him there. After his release and still madly in love with her, Victor will stop at nothing to win her over even if means revenge, for Elena has married David, the cop who sent him to prison!
movies.chineseTagline: 生命、爱情、欲望……以及其间的一切。
movies.chineseSynopsis: 1970年，平安夜。妓女伊莎贝尔（佩内洛普•克鲁兹 Penélope Cruz 饰）临盆在即，情急之下，老鸨舍命拦车，结果她在车上产下一子，取名维克多。20年后，维克多爱上了跟他有染的女孩艾莲娜，但约会却被放鸽子。气愤的维克多登门造访，被犯毒瘾的艾莲娜以枪相逼。两人僵持时，警察桑丘和大卫（贾维尔•巴登 Javier Bardem 饰）刚好经过。此前，醉酒驾车的桑丘正在跟同事倾诉老婆偷情之事。在对抗中，大卫被维克多射伤导致下肢瘫痪，后者因此锒铛入狱。6年后，入狱期满的维克多在电视中看到了残疾运动员大卫，后者代表西班牙队参加92年巴塞罗那残奥会，并赢得了篮球金牌。维克多要找大卫复仇，却跟大卫妻子成了同事，这阴错阳差的背后竟隐藏着惊人的秘密……

movies.title: 24 Flavors
movies.synopsis: After years abroad, April returns to her homeland, discovering her divorced parents rekindling old ties. Memories of her extreme self-harm resurface as she grapples with her father's infidelity. Facing the impending demolition of the tea shop, April must decide between taking her mother Qiaozhen abroad or supporting her desire to continue the business. Struggling Yongtang silently raises funds for Qiaozhen's shop reopening, inadvertently falling into a scam. April also encounters her resilient half-sister Xiaojing. Amidst the challenges, she begins to reclaim the life, time, and self-reflection she had long avoided.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 出国多年后回到故土的四月（袁澧林 饰），发现早已离异的父母重拾旧好，年少时她以极端自虐的方式挽留出轨父亲（钟镇涛 饰）的记忆再度浮现。凉茶铺正面临拆迁，四月要带巧珍（张艾嘉 饰）出国生活，巧珍却希望继续经营凉茶铺。重回家庭的落魄永堂默默为巧珍筹措重开凉茶铺的资金，拼尽全力却误中骗局。一团乱麻时，四月又遇野蛮生长、同父异母的妹妹小景。她将过去逃避的生活、时间以及自省一点点拾起。

movies.title: Crossing
movies.synopsis: A retelling of the Red Army crossing the Chishui River four times to outmaneuver 400,000 enemy troops.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 长征时期的红军，是绝境。 四渡赤水，是红军的绝地反击。 毛泽东带领红军，从一渡的被迫无奈，到二渡的出其不意，再到三渡的精妙一笔，最后到四渡的神操作，创造了战争史上的经典战例，游击战的传奇。

movies.title: 循环街区
movies.synopsis: Now screening across Melbourne, Sydney, and Shanghai cinemas.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 你觉得，这个世界是真实的吗？  　　当周杭溪（邓家佳 饰）一觉醒来，却发现自己身处陌生时空。没有记忆，没有身份，甚至她脱口而出的“杭州”也从未有人听闻，但脑海中不断闪回的“西湖”与“海鸥”，却又无比真实。  　　当身份与过往凭空更迭，在这座为爱搭建的虚拟城池中，一扇扇通往不同世界的门悄然出现，她是否有勇气推开它们，打破循环？

movies.title: The Cat in the Hat
movies.tagline: The cat's out of the bag.
movies.synopsis: Assigned his toughest mission yet, the Cat must cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian as they adjust to life in a new town. Known for pushing boundaries, this agent of chaos must prove himself or risk losing his magical hat forever.
movies.chineseTagline: 帽子一戴，脑洞大开。
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自苏斯博士创作的同名儿童绘本。一只古灵精怪的猫接到最艰巨的任务：帮助一对因搬家而闷闷不乐的兄妹加比和塞巴斯蒂安重拾快乐。这场充满魔法与恶作剧的冒险，也可能成为他证明自己的最后机会，否则就将失去魔法帽。

movies.title: The Shawshank Redemption
movies.tagline: Fear can hold you prisoner. Hope can set you free.
movies.synopsis: Imprisoned in the 1940s for the double murder of his wife and her lover, upstanding banker Andy Dufresne begins a new life at the Shawshank prison, where he puts his accounting skills to work for an amoral warden. During his long stretch in prison, Dufresne comes to be admired by the other inmates -- including an older prisoner named Red -- for his integrity and unquenchable sense of hope.
movies.chineseTagline: 恐惧会将你囚禁，希望则能让你获得自由。
movies.chineseSynopsis: 1947年，银行家安迪·杜佛兰因被控杀害妻子及其情人，尽管始终坚称清白，仍被判处两项无期徒刑，送入缅因州的肖申克监狱服刑。在残酷而压抑的监狱生活中，安迪凭借冷静、智慧和始终未曾熄灭的希望逐渐赢得狱友们的尊重，并与能够在狱中弄到各种物品的瑞德建立起深厚的友谊。漫长的岁月里，他始终没有让高墙彻底改变自己，也开始用自己的方式影响身边的人，以及这座看似牢不可破的监狱……

movies.title: 谜岛
movies.tagline: 上海院线热映佳作 · Now Screening in Shanghai.
movies.synopsis: Currently screening across Shanghai cinemas (Mystery). Select any session time for hall details and live Maoyan box-office pricing.

movies.title: 我的答案之城
movies.tagline: 上海院线热映佳作 · Now Screening in Shanghai.
movies.synopsis: Currently screening across Shanghai cinemas (Documentary). Select any session time for hall details and live Maoyan box-office pricing.

movies.title: Wild Strawberries
movies.synopsis: Crotchety retired doctor Isak Borg travels from Stockholm to Lund, Sweden, with his unhappy daughter-in-law, Marianne, in order to receive an honorary degree from his alma mater. Along the way, they encounter a series of hitchhikers, each of whom causes the elderly doctor to muse upon the pleasures and failures of his own life. These include the vivacious young Sara, a dead ringer for the doctor's own first love.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 伊萨克（维克多·斯约斯特洛姆 饰）从医50年，现年已是将近八十岁的高龄，正准备在儿媳的陪伴下返回母校接受荣誉学位颁发。路上伊萨克顺道重游旧地，追忆往事。伊萨克曾经和堂妹萨拉（毕比·安德森 饰）有过美好的初恋，却因性格冷酷孤僻，以致他的兄弟乘虚而入。如今伊萨克坐在草坪上，忆起往昔，眼前浮现萨拉白衣飘飘的美丽模样。 他与生俱来的冷漠理智的性格，注定了婚姻的失败。伊萨克的妻子无法忍受冰冷的婚姻，寻求外遇。这样的家庭气氛，加上遗传下来的冷漠秉性，使得伊萨克的儿子不愿生小孩，和儿媳关系决裂。伊萨克获得了光荣的学位荣誉，然而他仍然沉浸在对过往沉重的自省中，对于生命将尽的老人，这仿佛是一次心灵救赎之旅。

movies.title: 顾炎武
movies.synopsis: Now screening across Melbourne, Sydney, and Shanghai cinemas.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 主要讲述了顾炎武还乡途中，回忆平生：“誓不仕清”；身陷文字狱却因书未成不敢轻生；将弟子送进清朝“博学鸿儒科”考场；生命终时向少年康熙解读“何谓亡国，何谓亡天下”的故事。

movies.title: Blink Your Eyes
movies.synopsis: Now screening across Melbourne, Sydney, and Shanghai cinemas.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 一次伸手相助的善意让黎响（佟丽娅 饰）被判过失杀人，不甘心的她携手失意律师韩铮（王皓 饰），与多年未见的三位老友王海燕（王智 饰）、李欣怡（吴优 饰）、刘思涵（王丽坤 饰），一同踏上和时间赛跑的寻证之路。

movies.title: 金哲
movies.synopsis: Now screening across Melbourne, Sydney, and Shanghai cinemas.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 1983年夏，七岁的尚民到吉童村姥姥家过暑假，遇见了被全村叫作"傻子"的金哲。山野间的疯跑嬉戏，抓河蚌、捉迷藏，让尚民读懂了他藏在"傻"背后的孤独，而这份不掺杂质的陪伴，也让长久被轻视的金哲，第一次萌生出了为自己赢一次的勇气。夏末，村里摔跤赛开场，金哲第一次代表村子站上赛场赢得尊严。

movies.title: 西游记之真假美猴王
movies.synopsis: Now screening across Melbourne, Sydney, and Shanghai cinemas.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 讲述了唐僧师徒四人去西天取经途中，悟空偶遇五百年前同自己一起“大闹天宫”的兄弟六耳。六耳希望悟空为当年一战复仇，这使悟空陷入了两难的境地。两人的矛盾愈演愈烈，而这背后似乎隐藏着更大的阴谋。

movies.title: Long Live the Mistress!
movies.synopsis: A man who becomes wealthy starts to have an affair and though his wife knows of it, she says nothing. Soon, the affair starts to have consequences and his business falls apart while the man’s sister starts to have a relationship with the brother of his wife.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 秀外慧中的好媳妇陈思珍（蒋天流饰）自与丈夫唐志远（张伐饰）结婚后，便把家里的人际关系处理得很好，持家有道。一日，思珍的弟弟陈思瑞（韩非饰）从台湾到上海省亲，邂逅志远的妹妹唐志琴（汪漪饰），两人一见钟情。然而因为陈父（石挥饰）不肯资助自己筹办公司的志远，却极力反对这桩亲事。思珍只得谎称唐家存有金条美钞，陈父才同意资助志远办起公司。不料发迹致富的志远却有了外遇，与姨太太（上官云珠饰）有染。思珍为了顾全丈夫名誉，只得委曲求全。未几，志远破产，谎言败露，两家人也因此闹翻。终于，思珍决定与志远离婚，却在律师事务遇见了秘密登记结婚的思瑞、志琴两人。面对真心相爱的一对有情人，思珍该何去何从。  　　由中国著名导演桑弧执导于1947年摄制的黑白影片《太太万岁》是小说家张爱玲的电影经典剧作。桑弧含蓄细腻的电影风格与张爱玲的剧作交相辉映。

movies.title: Bullets Over Broadway
movies.synopsis: After young playwright, David Shayne obtains funding for his play from gangster Nick Valenti, Nick's girlfriend Olive miraculously lands the role of a psychiatrist—but not only is she a bimbo who could never pass for a psychiatrist—she's a dreadful actress. David puts up with the leading man who is a compulsive eater, the grand dame who wants her part jazzed up, and Olive's interfering hitman/bodyguard—but, eventually he must decide whether art or life is more important.
movies.chineseTagline: 一部绝妙的喜剧！
movies.chineseSynopsis: 长久以来，剧作家大卫（约翰·库萨克 饰）都过着郁郁不得志的生活，艺术家特有的清高让他对如今腐败混乱的话剧界充满了失望之情。为了讨好情妇奥利芙（詹妮弗·提莉 饰），黑帮大佬看中了名不见经传的大卫的剧本想要投资，作为前提条件 ，大卫必须让奥利芙饰演主角。虽然奥利芙唠叨的个性和蹩脚的演技让大卫深感抓狂，但在利益面前，他痛苦的屈服了。就这样，一个奇怪的剧组诞生了。 剧本的漏洞，女演员们之间的矛盾，男主演日益肥胖的身材都让大卫感到绝望，但令他惊奇的是，一直监视着奥利芙的保镖契奇（查兹·帕尔明特瑞 饰）在无意中展现了过人的编剧才能。在契奇的帮助下，被改写的剧本居然获得了盛大的成功，与此同时，契奇对由自己操刀的剧本展现出的病态执着和剧组里混乱的男女关系让大卫陷入了另一个困境……

movies.title: Embers
movies.synopsis: Huang Yan, a terminally ill crematorium worker, accidentally mixed up two sets of ashes during her work. When she confessed the truth, neither family wanted to swap them back. Only Yao Xue, the daughter of one of the deceased, believed Huang Yan. The two embarked on a wild and absurd journey to return the ashes, where they came to understand life anew and chose to live bravely in the face of death.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 黄燕（宋佳 饰）在按部就班的火化工作中逐渐失去了对生活的期待，变得悲观麻木。直到她意识到自己终将死亡，才决定更勇敢、更大胆地活出自我。一次意外，让她与通透、明媚的姚雪（文淇 饰）相遇。她们彼此治愈，像冬天里靠在一起取暖的两个人；她们互相擦干眼泪，勇敢做自己想做的事，把自己放在人生的第一位，一起体验这仅有一次的人生！

movies.title: The Sacrifice
movies.tagline: The final film of Andrei Tarkovsky
movies.synopsis: Alexander, a journalist, philosopher and retired actor, celebrates a birthday with friends and family when it is announced that nuclear war has begun.
movies.chineseTagline: 安德烈·塔可夫斯基的最后一部电影。
movies.chineseSynopsis: 当一个富裕的瑞典家庭正在庆祝家长亚历山大（厄兰·约瑟夫森 饰）的生日时，第三次世界大战爆发的消息传到了他们偏远的波罗的海小岛上——欢快的气氛骤然转为恐怖。这个家庭陷入了心理上的崩塌，塔尔科夫斯基以引人注目的、发光的灰色调笼罩着家园周围荒凉的风景，精彩地渲染出这种状态。对于这位因人类缺乏灵性而深感困扰的哲学家亚历山大来说，即将到来的毁灭迫使他做出终极牺牲；为了拯救被恐惧笼罩的亲人，他与上帝达成了一场浮士德式的交易。

movies.title: Dogville
movies.tagline: A quiet little town not far from here.
movies.synopsis: A woman on the run from the mob is reluctantly accepted in a small Colorado community in exchange for labor, but when a search visits the town, she learns that their support has a price.
movies.chineseTagline: 离此不远的一个宁静小镇。
movies.chineseSynopsis: 封闭守旧的美国小镇闯进了一个神秘女子格蕾斯（妮可·基德曼 饰）。她美丽善良，正在逃避歹徒追杀。镇中的作家汤姆力劝村民留下这个女子，让她暂时在镇里避过难关。然而条件就是格蕾丝要干各种农活来偿还。人们同意了，不久后却发现格蕾丝是一个通缉中的逃犯。大家要把格蕾丝赶走，最后答应，如果她更卖力的干活，才可以在这里逗留。 格蕾丝日以继夜的劳作，终难逃过不幸的事情发生。一个镇民在警察搜捕后，强暴了格蕾丝。龌龊的事情拉开了序幕：人们开始随意的污辱她，甚至连汤姆，也揭开了善良的面具，格蕾斯沦为镇上的一条狗，干活，受罪，善良的心也有了渐渐的改变。镇上的人怎么也想不到，这个女子的神秘身世，让此刻的污辱成为了他日的灭顶之灾。

movies.title: The Legend of the Swordsman
movies.synopsis: Ling Wu Chung decides to hide from the chaotic world. Before leaving, he visits his friends, a tribe of snake-wielding women warriors. However, he finds that the tribe have been attacked, and their leader Yam Ying Ying has been abducted.
movies.chineseTagline: 天下风云出我辈,一入江湖岁月催。 皇图霸业谈笑中,不胜人间一场醉
movies.chineseSynopsis: 华山派大弟子令狐冲（李连杰 饰）在经历江湖纷争后，本欲与师妹岳灵珊（李嘉欣 饰）及众师弟一同归隐，退出江湖。然而，此时的武林正被一场巨大阴谋笼罩。日月神教教主东方不败（林青霞 饰）凭借绝世武功《葵花宝典》篡权，囚禁了原教主任我行（任世官 饰），并勾结东瀛浪人，意图颠覆朝廷。 令狐冲在途中偶遇一位超凡脱俗的神秘女子，两人月下对饮，引为知己，令狐冲更对这位女子暗生情愫。他全然不知，眼前这位佳人，正是他受朋友任盈盈（关之琳 饰）和蓝凤凰（袁洁莹 饰）所托、计划要铲除的魔教枭雄东方不败。 与此同时，东方不败为巩固权势，开始铲除教内异己。当令狐冲得知自己的同门师兄弟惨遭东方不败毒手时，他义愤填膺，决心联手任盈盈、向问天（刘洵 饰）以及被救出的任我行，攻上黑木崖，为同门报仇。 在最终的决战中，令狐冲震惊地发现，那个与自己有过一段情缘、刻骨铭心的神秘女子，竟然就是他要手刃的仇敌东方不败。爱恨交织与江湖大义在前，两人展开了一场惊天动地的生死对决。东方不败虽武功盖世，但因对令狐冲手下留情，最终坠下悬崖。 风波平息后，重掌大权的任我行变得与昔日的东方不败一样专横，开始大肆清除异己。令狐冲看透江湖权力斗争的循环与虚妄，心灰意冷之下，选择携师妹岳灵珊浪迹天涯，真正远离这个纷扰的江湖。

movies.title: Céline and Julie Go Boating
movies.synopsis: Julie, a daydreaming librarian, meets Céline, an enigmatic magician, and together they become the heroines of a time-warping adventure involving a haunted house, psychotropic candy, and a murder-mystery melodrama.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 魔术师塞琳和图书馆员朱丽是好朋友，自从在巴黎相识后，她俩分享所有的一切，包括衣服和男友。当她们分享一种魔术糖果后，来到一个超现实的世界的一座闹鬼的屋子里。在那里，她们都爱上了塞琳担任家庭教师那个女孩的父亲，但该男子在妻子去世前曾承诺，只要重病的女儿仍活在世上，就不会再结婚……

movies.title: The Turin Horse
movies.synopsis: A look at the monotonous daily struggle of a father and daughter in a windswept, desolate landscape. Over six days, their routine of eating boiled potatoes and tending a failing horse crumbles, symbolizing a slow descent into darkness, emptiness, and the end of existence.
movies.chineseSynopsis: “1889年1月3日，都灵。弗里德里克·尼采在维亚·卡罗·艾尔波特酒店的六号门前驻足。他的目光被酒店外的一个马车吸引。不远的地方，停着一辆小马车。马车的车夫遭遇到了一匹倔强的马。不管车夫怎么喊叫，马匹根本没有要移动的意思。最终，车夫失去了耐心，拿起了鞭子，朝马匹打去。尼采见到此番情景，挤进人群，冲到马匹跟前，阻止住马夫，抱住马的脖子，痛哭起来。酒店的主人赶来，拉走了尼采。回到酒店的尼采在沙发上安安静静地、一动不动地躺了两天。随后，他小声地说了几句话。接下来，就是尼采精神错乱、神经颠颠的十年，由他的妹妹和母亲照顾的日子。谁也不知道，在都灵，在那匹马的身上，在尼采的心里，发生了什么。”

movies.title: Paris Belongs to Us
movies.synopsis: A young woman joins a theatrical troupe where she slowly believes that the director is involved with a secret group and that he is in grave danger.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 1957年巴黎文学女青年安妮在哥哥皮埃尔的引荐下来到他朋友的一个聚会。聚会上的宾客包括有逃避迈卡锡主义的美国流亡分子菲利普·考夫曼，一名带着神秘女子特里的戏剧导演杰拉尔·朗兹。聚会上的话题有关他们的朋友胡安的自杀事件，他是西班牙激进主义分子，最近刚和特里分手。菲利普警告安妮杰拉尔很快也会像胡安那样遭遇不测。而缺乏资金支持的杰拉尔却正在努力排演莎士比亚戏剧“伯里克利”。安妮在剧中出演角色帮助杰拉尔，同时也在找寻胡安死亡的真正原因。

movies.title: L'Amour fou
movies.synopsis: A troubled marriage is tested by the couple's involvement in a theatrical production of Racine’s Andromaque.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 新剧开始也是恋情终结，爱情却不是戏剧，完场与离场间的弥留，足以令人堕进情绪深渊。希腊悲剧彩排现场，纪录片队伍拍摄实况，女主角不抵压力退出，导演男友换上旧情人，紧张关系濒临崩溃。利维特视剧场为真实与虚构交汇相生的神秘领域，第三作已实验性超然，捕捉即兴火花。35米厘摄下的戏剧与16米厘纪录片段交错辩证，冲击创作与纪实本质，亦是男女两种感性的互动。布乐奥芝亚与尚彼亚卡丰忘情剖开灵魂深处，真情与表演无以分界，创造划时代经典。

movies.title: The Messenger: The Story of Joan of Arc
movies.synopsis: In 1429, a French teenager stood before her King with a message she claimed came from God; that she would defeat the world's greatest army and liberate her country from its political and religious turmoil. As she reclaims God's diminished kingdom, this courageous young woman has various amazing victories until her violent and untimely death.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 14世纪爆发的英法持续超过百年，法国节节败退，大部分国土都被英国占领了。就在这个时候，珍妮（米拉•乔沃维奇 Milla Jovovich 饰）出生在法国的穷乡僻壤中。年少起，珍妮就经常看到各种幻想。一次，她看到幻想并根据指示找到了一把剑，当她带着剑回到家时发现家里已遭英军蹂躏。珍妮知道是上天安排她来捍卫法国。于是她向当时的皇太子查理（约翰•马尔科维奇 John Malkovich 饰）请求率领一支军队去抗击英军。走投无路的查理答应了珍妮的请求。随后珍妮率领法军节节胜利，查理亦顺利登基。登基后的查理不再需要珍妮帮助，珍妮在以后的一次战斗中陷入困境但无人来救，她被英军捉住并带到了英国审批……

movies.title: Le Pont du Nord
movies.synopsis: Marie is just out from prison when she runs into Baptiste, a young paranoid needing companionship. In their pursuit of a mysterious briefcase carried by Marie's former lover, they roam the street of Paris, transformed into a giant board game, a maze spotted with mysterious traps, puzzling clues, and chance encounters. Maybe they are bricks in some sinister scheme, maybe they are playing a board game, maybe it's a fairy tale, maybe it's yet something else...
movies.chineseSynopsis: 玛丽刚从监狱出来，就遇到了巴蒂斯特。巴蒂斯特是一个需要陪伴的偏执狂。 为了寻找玛丽前情人携带的神秘公文包，她们在巴黎街头游荡。巴黎化身为一个巨大的棋盘、一个布满神秘陷阱、谜团线索、偶遇的迷宫……

movies.title: Never Too Late
movies.synopsis: Centers on a married couple in their 80s who decide to divorce, which proves shocking news to the small country-town community of Huaihua in Hunan province. Director Yang, who is their granddaughter, unpicks the story behind the separation and a marriage that began 60 years ago through matchmaking.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 奶奶邓桂英和爷爷杨乔元在80岁时选择了离婚，结束了六十年的包办婚姻。这一举动在当地引起了不小的轰动。杨乔元，一个人住在肮脏破旧的平房里，与周围的人格格不入。而在慢慢衰退的记忆中，邓桂英依旧清楚地记得年轻时爱慕的店员。孙女杨骊珠为了了解爷爷奶奶离婚背后的故事，拿起相机，走进了他们的生活。

movies.title: Mon Oncle
movies.tagline: Mr Hulot takes a precious, playful and purely premeditated look at modern times...
movies.synopsis: Genial, bumbling Monsieur Hulot loves his top-floor apartment in a grimy corner of the city, and cannot fathom why his sister's family has moved to the suburbs. Their house is an ultra-modern nightmare, which Hulot only visits for the sake of stealing away his rambunctious young nephew. Hulot's sister, however, wants to win him over to her new way of life, and conspires to set him up with a wife and job.
movies.chineseTagline: 赫尔洛先生以一种珍贵、俏皮……且纯粹预谋的眼光审视着现代时光……
movies.chineseSynopsis: 于洛先生（雅克·塔蒂 饰）从乡下来，到了巴黎的姐姐（阿德里安娜·色万提 饰）家里小住，对姐姐家中各种现代化设备极其不适应，经常被搞得手忙脚乱。还好小侄子杰拉德喜欢这个舅舅，和他到处去玩，杰拉德同样不喜欢家里的现代化设备，因此于洛还带他去郊区老屋玩耍。于洛的姐夫阿尔贝勒先生（让·皮埃尔·佐拉 饰）帮于洛在自己工厂找了一份工作，可是于洛同样不适应现代化的操作机器，搞砸了许多事情，闹了许多笑话，姐夫对他忍无可忍，决定介绍另一份工作打发他离开，而于洛开心地同小侄子话别，只当结束了一个不同寻常的假期……

movies.title: Blood Simple
movies.tagline: Passion led to Adultery. Adultery led to Murder. It all seemed so simple...
movies.synopsis: The owner of a seedy small-town Texas bar discovers that one of his employees is having an affair with his wife. A chaotic chain of misunderstandings, lies and mischief ensues after he devises a plot to have them murdered.
movies.chineseTagline: 激情酿成奸情，奸情引发谋杀。一切看似如此顺理成章……
movies.chineseSynopsis: 科恩兄弟贯穿创作生涯的、穿越边缘美国的暗黑喜剧之旅，正是从这部锐利冰冷的德州新黑色电影启程。片中一位卑劣的酒馆老板因一念杀机掀起了腥风血雨，演员麦·艾美特·华许以黄西装、牛仔帽和全然失序的道德准则化身游走于罪案中的滑头侦探，弗兰西斯·麦克多蒙德精妙的银幕首秀则预示了她通往巨星之路的起点。科恩兄弟数十年创作中标志性的严密剧本与独创风格，在此首部作品中已全然显现：摄影指导巴里·索南菲尔德摒弃黑白明暗对照法，转而运用霓虹灯与点唱机色彩的视觉交响，搭配卡特·伯威尔萦绕心头的配乐，营造出悚丽而震颤的视听效果。本片融汇廉价小说与低成本恐怖片的元素，为新一代观众重塑了黑色电影范式，标志着一个将改变美国独立电影格局的创作集体的登场。

movies.title: A Better Tomorrow
movies.tagline: Brothers by blood. Enemies by chance. Killers by nature.
movies.synopsis: A reforming ex-gangster tries to reconcile with his estranged policeman brother, but the ties to his former gang are difficult to break.
movies.chineseTagline: 血脉相连的兄弟。命运捉弄的仇敌。天性使然的杀手。
movies.chineseSynopsis: 香港某个国际伪钞集团重要分子宋子豪（狄龙）和Mark（周润发）情同手足，某次宋子豪带手下谭成（李子雄）去台北交易时被其出卖受枪伤被捕入狱，为替好兄弟报仇，Mark孤身赴台，结果被人打成瘸子，江湖地位自此一落千丈，而宋子豪的父亲也在不久丧命。一向视宋子豪为偶像的宋子杰得知哥哥的真实身份后，对黑社会及他恨之人骨，立誓利用警察身份将黑帮势力斩草除根，宋子豪出狱后不顾苦等他想重创辉煌的Mark的劝阻，决心弃暗投明，无奈得不到宋子杰的谅解。而此时已成帮会老大的谭成欲找宋子豪再合作，遭拒绝后放言会害宋子杰，被逼走投无路，宋子豪决定再与Mark连手共抗强敌。

movies.title: Leningrad Cowboys Go America
movies.synopsis: The Leningrad Cowboys, a group of Siberian musicians, and their manager, travel to America seeking fame and fortune. As they cross the country, trying to get to a wedding in Mexico, they are followed by the village idiot, who wishes to join the band.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 列宁格勒牛仔摇滚乐队的几个成员装扮怪异，戴大墨镜，烫飞机头，夸张的火箭鞋就是他们的标志。可在他们的家乡看不见事业成功的希望，于是他们决定转战美国寻求机会，在即将出发的前夜，吉他手却被冻死，尽管如此，队员们还是将他装入了放满冰块的木箱中带上了旅途。此时同村的一个怪异的哑巴偷偷跟随乐队来到了纽约。纽约的机会并不如他们想象的丰富，困窘的生活仍在继续，在他们走投无路之时，得到了一个来自墨西哥的婚宴演出机会。于是他们用仅剩的钱从一个美国售货员（吉姆·贾木许 饰）手中买了一辆旧车后继续向墨西哥进发，那里有他们最后的梦想……

movies.title: Faces Places
movies.synopsis: Director Agnès Varda and photographer/muralist JR journey through rural France and form an unlikely friendship.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 作为阿涅斯·瓦尔达提名奥斯卡的晚年力作，这部充满手工温度的人文主义杰作，记录下八旬导演与三十余岁的街头摄影师JR的跨界合作。二人驾驶可即时输出巨幅肖像的摄影车，穿梭于法国乡间，将沿途相遇的农民、退役矿工、码头工人等普通人的肖像张贴于当地墙垣。这些故事拼贴出一幅传统在现代化浪潮中绵延的国度图景。这部布满岔路的公路电影、迷人的跨代际伙伴电影，以及献给各行匠人的颂歌，在瓦尔达追溯往昔与编织新忆的过程中，最终凝结成对艺术、人际关系与生命本身转瞬即逝的深刻沉思。[标准收藏]

movies.title: Sirāt
movies.synopsis: A man and his son arrive at a rave lost in the mountains of Morocco. They are looking for Marina, their daughter and sister, who disappeared months ago at another rave. Driven by fate, they decide to follow a group of ravers in search of one last party, in hopes Marina will be there.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 在地下狂欢派对的震耳低音中，路易斯（塞尔希·洛佩斯 饰）与儿子埃斯特班穿越沙漠，寻找几个月前在派对中失踪的女儿兼姐姐玛尔。随着他们深入这片炽热、混乱的边境地带，面对陌生的自由与逐渐崩塌的秩序，他们不仅在寻找亲人，也在寻找自我。影片以纪录片质感的长镜头与沉默的凝视，构建出一场关于极限、信仰与家庭的灵性旅程。

movies.title: 民宿惊魂
movies.synopsis: Now screening across Melbourne, Sydney, and Shanghai cinemas.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 孤岛荒宿，情侣旅行撞上民宿阴宅，一桩桩离奇事件接踵而至：镜子里的鬼脸、暗室里密布的红绳、突然扭动的门把手、泳池里惊现的鬼影……夜晚怪事连连，一觉惊魂醒来，所有诡异痕迹却全部消失不见……是凶宅幻视？无尽梦魇？还是有人布下猎杀圈套？

movies.title: V
movies.synopsis: In the early 1990s, this city of desire, once a land of opportunity, was plagued by rampant crime and a breakdown of order. Man Tsz-keung, a working-class man desperate to change his fate, meets flight attendant Lok Ka-yuen, and the two team up to rob a large sum of money. This success fuels Man Tsz-keung's madness, pushing him into a deeper power struggle with wealthy businessman Chan Fai-yin. Meanwhile, mainland police officer Qi Honggang and Hong Kong police officer Guan Suchen continue their investigation of Wan Ziqiang, leading to a joint operation between the two police forces, setting the stage for a clash between good and evil. This film is fictional.
movies.chineseTagline: 五声空响，妄念成空
